verdict.rationale: Choosing your own model or API key is a fair question for an agent platform like Factory, but the evidence pack never documents bring-your-own-key or custom model selection. The only 'bring your own' feature is BYOM (Bring Your Own Machine), which lets you register your own compute, not your own LLM. It is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice
